关系网记录包含未知字段: The network record contains unknown fields.
关系网节点不存在于当前公司: The network node does not exist in this company.
收益归属需要准确来源: Profit attribution requires exact evidence references.
source_refs 需要一至一百项准确来源: source_refs requires 1 to 100 exact evidence references.
来源版本必须为正整数且不可重复: Evidence revisions must be positive integers without duplicate references.
收益金额必须为非负整数最小货币单位或 null: Attribution amounts must be nonnegative integer minor currency units or null.
关系网记录超过大小限制: The network record exceeds the size limit.
关系的两端必须不同: A relationship must connect two different nodes.
关系结束日期早于开始日期: The relationship end date precedes its start date.
收益期间结束日早于开始日: The attribution period ends before it starts.
成本完整时必须提供已归属成本: Complete cost coverage requires a recorded attributable cost.
同一对象同口径的收益期间不能重叠: Attribution periods for the same subject and basis must not overlap.
同一资金来源同口径不可重复归属收益: The same cash evidence must not be attributed twice under the same basis.
关系网来源的准确版本不存在于当前公司: The exact network evidence revision does not exist in this company.
收益筛选必须同时提供起止日期: Attribution filters require both a start and an end date.
收益口径必须为 cash 或 recognized: The attribution basis must be cash or recognized.
读取公司关系网与有依据的客户收益归属: Read the company network and evidence-based customer attribution.
关系只引用当前公司档案，不访问其他公司的记录: Relationships reference only this company's records and never read another company.
客户收益按明确期间和口径展示；缺少完整成本时利润保持未知: Customer attribution has an explicit period and basis; profit remains unknown without complete costs.
维护经营人物与关联组织: Maintain business characters and associated organizations.
维护本公司客户、合作与组织关系: Maintain this company's customer, partnership and organization relationships.
登记客户与业务的收入成本归属: Record revenue and cost attribution for customers and business activities.
仅引用本公司节点和准确来源版本；公司节点只允许当前公司标识: Reference only this company's nodes and exact evidence revisions; a company node must use this company's identifier.
更新复用稳定标识并提供记录 expected_revision，准确重试复用 r: Updates reuse stable identifiers and the record's expected_revision; exact retries reuse request_id.
同一对象同口径期间不能重叠，同一资金来源同口径不可重复归属: Periods for the same subject and basis must not overlap; the same cash evidence cannot be attributed twice under one basis.
利润为已记录收入减完整已归属成本；成本不完整或收入未知时利润未知，不用现金余额或: Profit is recorded revenue less complete attributable costs. Profit stays unknown when revenue or full costs are missing; cash balance and ARR cannot substitute for profit.
模拟收益写明假设；真实收益使用实际依据；结束关系或撤销收益保留历史: State assumptions for simulation attribution and actual evidence for real attribution; ending relationships or voiding attribution preserves history.
维护公司关系与可追溯收益归属: Maintain company relationships and traceable attribution.
先查询公司关系网，复用已有客户、业务、资源和人物标识，人物用稳定称呼和具体角色: Read the network first and reuse existing customer, business, resource and character identifiers. Use stable character names and concrete roles.
公司根节点只代表当前公司；关联企业建立 organization 档案，不读取或: The root represents only this company. Associated businesses use organization records; never read or link unauthorized company data.
根据真实依据或模拟历史保存合作、供应、竞争、团队及依赖关系；关系变化保留版本和日: Record partnerships, suppliers, competitors, team links and dependencies using real evidence or simulation history; retain revisions and dates as relationships change.
收益按对象、闭区间期间和 cash 或 recognized 口径登记。收入与成: Record attribution by subject, inclusive date range and cash or recognized basis. Unknown revenue or costs use null; incomplete costs use partial and do not establish profit.
收益来源引用本公司准确记录版本；同一对象同口径禁止期间重叠，同一资金来源不能重复: Attribution evidence references exact revisions in this company. Periods for the same subject and basis cannot overlap, and the same cash evidence cannot be attributed twice.
模拟金额附明确假设。真实收益不能从余额、融资、订阅规模或人物好感度推断: Simulation amounts include explicit assumptions. Real profit cannot be inferred from cash balance, funding, subscription scale or character affinity.
对玩家用人物、合作进展和关键收益取舍讲述关系变化；原始标识和接口回执留在维护过程: Describe changing relationships through characters, partnership progress and consequential revenue tradeoffs; keep raw identifiers and receipts in the maintenance workflow.
关系网记录包含系统维护字段: The network record contains system-managed fields.
